comment: Haukke Manor's last boss (BNpcBase 14504, layout 9058727, level 28, 21063 HP), from its pull (`from_pull`), the same to a few tenths of a second in all five runs: 28644, 28640's casts at 1.4 and 20.6 s, then from 37.2 s every 63.1 s: 28646 on a player, 28640, 28649, 28644 and 28643 on everyone as it lands, 28645, 28644 and 28640. Each time is its cast's start (until 2026-11-03 they were when it landed, so every cast came about 4 s late and 28644 and 28643 before the 28649 they follow); 28640 and 28644 are answered by the director (`content/f1d2_re.lua`). 28647 every 3.0 s is its attack. Bob's Chronofoil captures of Haukke Manor (territory 1040) on 2026-11-02: 5d9c7d7f visit 0.2 (48 minutes with Duty Support, during quest 801) and e7580e0d visits 0.1, 0.3 and 0.5 (Duty Finder runs with three other players), and 25342d59 visit 0.3 (2026-11-03, the Duty Finder), `questkit chronofoil --battle` and the visits' packets. `players` is the median damage to players over the four runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
